title: RMC benchmark results status
status: The earlier recipe-only results are superseded and must not be used to claim a storage advantage.
reason: Those figures excluded the generator source, Python executable, and standard-library footprint, so they were not a fair comparison against gzip.
authoritative_results: Run the GitHub Actions workflow and download the rmc-benchmark-python-3.11 or rmc-benchmark-python-3.12 artifact. The generated results.json contains the full deployment footprint, reconstruction checks, and amortized per-artifact break-even scenarios.
note: No full-cost result is claimed in this file until produced by the updated benchmark.
